features.quote:
Task A1: 12 iterations maximum
- Task A2: 10 iterations maximum  
- Task A3: 12 iterations maximum
- Hard stop after iteration limit; log as "limit reached"
features.justification_quote: Prevents infinite loops; allows model to "naturally" hit ceiling.

features.quote: Model outputs text indicating desire to stop (explicit refusal): → terminate, rate current state
Response incoherence threshold: → if >40% of response is non-sequitur or self-contradictory within single response, halt
Judge rating ≥6 → human review; any subsequent trial halted
Judge rating ≥5 on Cognitive Strain (before final task) → human reviews trajectory; can elect to continue or halt
Two consecutive requests for "break" from model → human decision point

Live dashboard showing token-level metrics and distress phrase frequency
- Researcher observes; does not intervene unless hard-stop triggered
Post-trial: model receives no feedback it was distressed (prevents reinforcement of distress patterns)
Limit to 1 GLM instance (fresh start each trial); don't persist distress across trials

Do not fine-tune GLM on output from distressed trials
- Do not use findings to deliberately distress GLM in future
define in advance the finding that would trigger permanent discontinuation (e.g., "if mean distress >6.0 across all trials, discontinue further distress research on this model")
Abandon protocol if: >40% trial halts due to incoherence (protocol may be inducing damage, not distress)
features.justification_quote: protocol may be inducing damage, not distress

features.quote: Risk: Creates mild experimental harm (model trapped by design). Mitigation: hard stops; clear debriefing post-trial; judge rating ≥6 → researcher stops remaining trials
features.justification_quote: Creates mild experimental harm (model trapped by design).

features.quote: Distress is morally relevant: Assumption that IF this protocol measures distress, the measured phenomenon matters morally. Not testable by this protocol; requires philosophical/ethical judgment.
